_comment: GH#196/#197 (mobile hotfix v0.12.1): tap-path proofs. (1) click_screen ON the title art satisfies the press-any-key gesture (previously the title panel consumed the click and the gate stuck). (2) Lyonette's order_brief (651 chars, multi-page) is advanced by PANEL TAPS; the keyboard confirm afterward picks option 0 -- if the taps had not turned pages, that confirm would advance a page instead of choosing, hub would never re-render, and the wait below reds. Extra taps on the last page are deliberate: with options visible the panel handler defers, so overshoot is a no-op (that contract is part of what this proves). This script sets qa_real_paging so the panel's jump-to-last-page QA contract is OFF -- page waits below are the honest observable.
